rows.scope_and_limits: Closed mesh with real modeled thickness nominal0.035 arbitrary model units. Thickness is inferred, not observed metric truth. No claim of continuous self-intersection/collision proof.
Closed capped vein geometry. Radius/attachment inferred; discrete finite-footprint samples passed, not continuous contact/source proof.
Single-sheet wave surface, no modeled bottom, volume or water depth. Finite boundary is a modeling extent, not observed lake boundary. Reflections do not imply lakebed.

Two finite ground-top surface sheets without bottom or side thickness. Bank profile, junction, submerged extent and supporting volume are unverified/inferred. Outdoor scene does not waive this limitation.
Zero-thickness foliage sheet proxies with double-sided shading, not closed leaf solids or measured leaf thickness. Exact instances and attachment are not source-confirmed.
Individually closed trunk/rachis meshes. This does not establish root contacts, inter-object collision freedom, or matching source plant topology.
Closed low-poly rock proxies. Position/shape/count/underwater contact inferred, not source-confirmed.
Must inspect individually before claiming a topology category.

limits: Individual topology checks do not prove whole-environment closed volume or physical/source contact. Do not add fake solids just to make every outdoor surface manifold.
